Use this page while you design your bridge.

::: {.card-grid cols="3"}
- Acute | angle 50 | Less than 90°. A sharp corner.
- Right | angle 90 | Exactly 90°. A square corner: mark it with a small box.
- Obtuse | angle 130 | More than 90°, less than 180°.
- Straight | angle 180 | Exactly 180°. A straight line.
- Reflex | angle 240 reflex | More than 180°, less than 360°.
- Full turn | angle 0 reflex | 360°. All the way around.
- Parallel | parallel | Lines that never meet. Always the same distance apart.
- Perpendicular | perpendicular | Lines that meet at a right angle.
- Measure it | 1. Put the centre on the vertex. 2. Line up 0 with one side. 3. Read where the other side crosses. | Use a protractor.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Design: an arch bridge

Draw a Roman bridge on the grid. It must carry a road or water across a valley.

::: {.panel title="Your design must have"}
☐ an acute angle   ☐ a right angle   ☐ an obtuse angle   ☐ a straight angle   ☐ labels on each angle
